title: Perfect t-embeddings: existence
summary: This note gives an affirmative answer to an open question posed in [Chelkak, Laslier, Russkikh'21]. Namely, it demonstrates the existence of perfect t-embeddings for each sufficiently non-degenerate planar bipartite graph $G$ with positive edge weights. The non-degeneracy condition on $G$ is formulated in terms of its perfect and almost perfect matchings and does not concern the choice of edge weights.
